_comment: Stable organization facts (AD-03). Values copied verbatim from the approved sources (docs/CANONICAL_FACTS.md + src/lib/schemas/entityGraph.ts). No PT incorporation year is asserted (owner decision 2026-08-03) — foundingDate 2015 is the brand/guesthouse era; 2023 is TDUP formalization. This file asserts NO rating. The public rating is single-source and live: jvto-web getAggregateRating.ts reads the live Prisma review_stats row first, falling back to credentials-and-public-evidence/review-platforms.json (profiles[].platform=='Google Maps'). Owner decision 2026-08-15 stands — Google Maps only, never a blended average (Trustpilot counts still conflict: review-platforms.json 51 vs jvto-web/src/lib/jvtoReviews.ts 44). A duplicate aggregateRating field lived here until 2026-08-19; nothing read it (build-organization.mjs builds the node from an explicit allowlist), and its snapshot had already drifted — 149 here vs 152 served in production — so it was removed rather than left as a trap for the next audit to 'reconnect'.

identifiers.description: Menkumham decree approving the legal entity PT Java Volcano Rendezvous, read verbatim from legal/AHU-PTJVR.pdf. Replaces 'AHU-0023020' (corrected 2026-08-21): that string was never an AHU number — it was a truncated fragment of the SABH registration number 4023020635102174 printed in the same decree, first committed as literal 'AHU-0023020...' with the note 'Truncated in source dataset; replace with full AHU number if available'. The ellipsis and the note were dropped later, promoting the fragment to look like an identifier.
Company-register entry recorded on the same decree.
Nomor Pendaftaran in the decree; also the kode parameter of the ahu.go.id verification QR.

hasCredential.name: TDUP (Tanda Daftar Usaha Pariwisata)
hasCredential._comment: The TDUP carries the same number as the NIB because Indonesia's OSS system issues the sectoral tourism licence against the business's NIB — this is normal OSS behaviour, not a duplicated identifier. Noted 2026-08-21 so the two credentials sharing a number does not read as an error.

hasCredential.name: HPWKI — Supervisory Board member (Pengawas · Anggota), held by founder Agung Sambuko
hasCredential.credentialCategory: Himpunan Pelaku Wisata Khusus Ijen — Ijen special-tourism association, supervised by BBKSDA Jawa Timur
hasCredential._comment: Corrected 2026-08-21 against the document itself. The PDF is Menkumham decree AHU-0001072.AH.01.07.TAHUN 2024 establishing HPWKI as a legal entity; its annex lists AGUNG SAMBUKO as PENGAWAS · ANGGOTA (supervisory board member). So the credential is a named position held by the founder, not a corporate membership held by PT Java Volcano Rendezvous, and AHU-0001072 is HPWKI's own legal-entity number, not a JVTO membership number. A supervisory seat outranks 'member', so stating it accurately is stronger, not weaker.

hasCredential.name: Menkumham decree — legal entity approval, PT Java Volcano Rendezvous
hasCredential._comment: Added 2026-08-21. The document was already public and hashed in the manifest but had never been declared as a credential, so the strongest corporate document JVTO holds was absent from the proof surface.

hasCredential.name: Surat Izin Praktik (SIP) — dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, Ijen pre-ascent screening physician
hasCredential.recognizedBy: DPMPTSP dan Tenaga Kerja Kabupaten Bondowoso
hasCredential._comment: Added 2026-08-21. Licence of the physician who signs the Ijen health certificates; STR QN00001073380217 valid to 2031-01-06, electronically signed via BSrE. Live and public since before this date but never declared.

hasCredential.name: BBKSDA Jawa Timur circular — TWA Kawah Ijen access regime
hasCredential.credentialCategory: Conservation-authority circular — regulates access to the Ijen crater area; not a permit issued to JVTO
hasCredential._comment: Added 2026-08-21 with the full circular number. The number published until now, 'SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024', was missing the K2/BIDTEK.1 segment and could not be matched against the document. Scope note: this circular reopens TWA Kawah Ijen from 2024-09-08 and names basic climbing safety gear plus 'protokol kesehatan yang berlaku'; it does not itself state the health-certificate requirement. The document establishing that requirement is being supplied separately by the owner and will be published and hashed here.
